tokenizer.json.source: identical tokenizer files copied from the fp16 source model

precision_decision.finding: 4-bit affine quantization collapses the seed-boundary next-token distribution that constrained decoding depends on: after the invariant seed '。', P(今天) drops 1.2e-3 -> 3.4e-6 while P(禁) rises 8x, flipping the r1 reference decode from 今天天气很好 (fp16) to 禁天天起很好. MLX fp16 (unquantized) and 8-bit both reproduce the torch fp16 distribution (今天 1.2e-3 / 1.3e-3). The MLX implementation itself is not at fault; 4-bit on this 0.5B is simply too lossy for the constrained route.
precision_decision.verdict: Deploy the 8-bit artifact. Model size 276MB -> 525MB, still half of fp16 (988MB), load and step latency re-measured in docs/baselines/constrained-qwen-v3-mlx.json.
